calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-08-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of three minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, 3689.

Petitioner, Ermina Manalang, was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minors Irish Ruiz, Matthew Ruiz and Angel Isabelle Ruiz, each of whom was at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and testified.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the minors to Irish Ruiz Manalang, Matthew Ruiz Manalang and Angel Ruiz Manalang, respectively.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
